name: Catch Weapon (Combat)
body:
You can use your shield to disarm unlucky foes.

Prerequisite(s): Shield Focus (light or heavy).

Benefit(s): When wielding a shield, if an opponent attacks you with a melee weapon and fails to hit your AC by 5 or more you may use an attack of opportunity to make a disarm combat maneuver attempt against that opponent. You gain a bonus on this attempt equal to your shield bonus to AC. This combat maneuver does not provoke an attack of opportunity from your target.
